Detailed Description.   Founded to bring clinically approved, non-invasive

wellness technologies to the pet market, this business is an industry-leading

ecommerce brand with unique, patent-protected products focused on improving

mobility, pain management, recovery, and overall well-being for pets.

The company’s flagship product utilizes red and infrared light therapy to help

reduce inflammation, improve mobility, and support recovery from injuries, while

its calming device uses proprietary PEMF technology to help reduce stress and

anxiety in pets. Together, they address two of the fastest-growing categories in

pet wellness—mobility and behavioral health—at a time when pet ownership and

spending are rapidly increasing.

What differentiates the brand is its emphasis on engineering-led product

innovation and IP, creating a growing portfolio of defensible IP in a category

where many competitors rely on generic, off-the-shelf solutions. The business

has built a highly attractive model centered on these products, with exceptional

economics and operations managed by a lean contractor-based team, requiring only

10–20 hours per week of owner involvement to maintain day-to-day operations.

This focus on product efficacy, usability, and product differentiation has

translated into strong customer satisfaction, approximately 1,000 reviews with a

4.8-star average rating, growing veterinary endorsement, and low return rates of

approximately 5%. Customer acquisition costs have declined from approximately

$123 in 2025 to $81 in 2026 YTD, while ROAS has steadily improved, highlighting

the strength of the brand’s positioning and marketing engine.

With significant opportunities remaining across paid channel expansion,

veterinary partnerships, international growth, lifecycle marketing, and product

line extension, this business represents a unique opportunity to acquire a

highly differentiated, IP-backed pet brand with proven unit economics, multiple

growth levers, and a strong foundation for continued scale.

investment to date, providing multiple avenues to accelerate growth.
